trajectory_clock: action_repeat physics steps per model step
method: Frozen active-policy trajectories at their original cadence. Each candidate is clamped and smoothed once, then held across its observation branch. Full state restored per arm; raw body paths and duplicate replay retained every model step.
acceptance: Collection only; no capability or fitted-model pass follows from collection.
fit_limit: No token fit. Separate physical-predictor declaration controls fitting and acceptance.
scale: Effect error: 1 = predict no difference between actions; 0 = predict each difference exactly.
